alignments.note: Hithpael with the reflexive pronoun that renders its voice (rule 44), headed on the lexical verb.
בְּ rendered by the compound because of, one rendering headed on the content word (rules 24 and 30).
Assimilated article; the ASV writes no the here (rules 12 and 29).
Hiphil participle rendered evil doers; doers is the supplied generic and the lexeme sits in evil (rule 31).
No waw stands in this colon, so Neither is what the ASV writes for the present negative itself (rule 14).
Verb with subject pronoun and copula, headed on the lexical predicate.
Assimilated article takes the written the.
Substantival adjective wicked; its determination is already carried by the article.

review_notes: The second colon has no conjunction morpheme, so Neither is read as the negative's own word rather than as a fused waw (rule 35 has nothing to fuse here) and is not added.
The head of evil doers is a live choice; rule 31's subtraction leaves the lexeme in evil, since the ASV never writes doers alone for this participle.
